How to use

The five-step ritual

Five quiet minutes, two to three times a week.

I

Apply

Apply a few drops directly to the scalp.

II

Massage

Massage gently in circular motions for 3–5 minutes.

III

Rest

Leave in for at least 30 minutes — or overnight before shampooing.

IV

Rinse

Rinse and shampoo as usual — always use before washing.

V

Repeat

Use 2–3 times per week for optimal results.

Formulated with care

Safe for every age

A natural formula without harsh ingredients — gentle enough for men, women, teenagers and children alike. Nature’s touch for your hair: carefully selected botanical oils and extracts that nourish your scalp, strengthen your hair, and bring out its natural beauty.

  • For external use only
  • Patch test on a small area of skin before first use
  • Avoid direct contact with eyes
  • Keep out of reach of children
  • Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight
  • Best used within 12 months of opening
